description: This file contains functions and logic for upgrading firmware and performing system upgrades on MediaTek MT7623-based devices, including full system upgrades, image checks, and configuration copying.

methods.name: legacy_mtk_mmc_full_upgrade
methods.description: Performs a full system upgrade for MediaTek MT7623 devices, handling partition comparisons, image writing, and firmware updates.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Main entry point for performing firmware upgrade based on device type and image.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks if the provided image file is valid for the current device.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies upgrade configuration files to the appropriate recovery partition or device location.
